videos.title: The simple short corner
videos.new_capability: player-ball synchronisation: ground passes, one simple run, elevated camera, basic tactical graphics

videos.title: The one-two corner
videos.new_capability: wall passes, changes of pace, turns, directional first touch, two-attacker timing

videos.title: The near-post run
videos.new_capability: aerial crosses, parabolic trajectories, near-post run, ball-run sync, first simple headers/finishes

videos.title: The dummy run
videos.new_capability: simultaneous movements, decoy runs, defensive reactions, changes of direction, space occupation

videos.title: The cutback corner
videos.new_capability: cutback pass, three-attacker coordination, shooting animations, new cameras, better ball contact

videos.title: The free-kick layoff
videos.new_capability: walls, preparation touches, shots, improved ball physics, defensive reactions

videos.title: The corner screen
videos.new_capability: close player interactions, marking, legal screens without punishable obstruction, multiple defensive reactions

videos.title: The ultimate corner routine
videos.new_capability: 5-6 coordinated movements, complex marking, crosses and finishes, animated goalkeeper, multiple cameras, advanced replays, simultaneous graphics
